Postponed on 21 Oct 2026: no time before February. Starting in February leaves little room for retakes before the June visa season. If February is still too busy, drop it until a later summer.
Avoid April–June: driving schools are saturated before summer, and that's also your visa season.
During January exams, drop to 1 lesson per week rather than stopping completely, so you don't lose the skill.
For a complete beginner, short frequent lessons (2–3 per week) beat long rare ones.
